content: Heitserie nepexeiya waɨkawamekɨ
Mɨkɨ meta, ne'iwama, xekeneyutemamawieka Ti'aitame hetsie xetewiyatɨ. Tawarita mɨpaɨ netixe'utɨirietɨ, nepɨnewaɨriya, niukikɨ nepɨka'uxiwe, 'aixɨa kaniyɨmɨkɨ matsi xehetsiemieme xekweriwa'anekaku.
Xekeneyukweriwayurieka mɨkɨ nemɨwaxatakai 'axamemɨteyurie wahepaɨtsita, mɨkɨ tsɨikɨri wahepaɨ memɨka'itiyatɨka, mɨkɨ wahepaɨtsita, xekeneyukweriwayurieka kememɨtexe'inɨaritɨaku xitekiyakɨ.

Tame pɨta Kakaɨyari 'inɨarieya tepexeiya, tame pɨta tepɨhɨkɨ Kakaɨyari temayexeiya 'Iyari kemaine, tame taheyemekɨ tekaninaki'aka Kɨritsitu Ketsutsi hetsie temɨtewiyakɨ, mɨkɨ meta, yuri tepɨkate'erie herie miemetsie.
Mɨkɨ kememɨ'anene herie mieme hetsie yuri memɨte'erie, neta mɨpaɨ nekani'aneni. Xɨka xewitɨ mɨpaɨ tiku'eriwani kename yɨwe herie miemetsie yuri mɨti'eriekakɨ, ne matsi waɨkawa nekaniyɨwenikeyu.

Ne'utinuiwaka 'atahairieka tukaritsie nekaniu'inɨaritɨarieni huriyutsixi waxitekiyakɨ, 'ixaheri teɨteriyari wahetsie Wenikamini nuiwariyari hetsie nekaniyeyani, hepɨrayu tewiyari nekanihɨkɨtɨni hepɨrayutsixi wahetsie nemɨyetɨa, 'inɨari niukiyaritsie kenemɨtiwiyakai, paritseu nekanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni.
Kenemɨtinewaɨriyakai yanetikamietɨ, nekaniwataweweiyakaitɨni memɨyutixexeɨriwakai, heitserie kenemɨrexeiyakai 'inɨari niukiyaritsie yanetikamietɨ, nehetsie pɨkarahɨiwakai yemekɨ.
Perutsɨ Kɨritsitu hetsie nemɨtiwiyakɨ mɨpaɨ nepɨtinemate, mɨkɨ naime nekatiniutatɨmaiya, naime kɨmana 'aixɨa nemɨ'itɨarienikekai.

Mɨkɨ meta, tsepa kemɨtitita, naitɨ katiniutatɨmaiyarieni kenemɨtixeiya, mɨpaɨ nemɨtinematekɨ, matsi yemekɨ 'aixɨa nekani'itɨariemɨkɨ ne'imaitɨ neti'aitɨwame Kɨritsitu Ketsutsi. Mɨkɨtsie nemɨmiemekɨ 'ari naime nekatiniutatɨmaiya, tsepanetɨ, mɨkɨ naitɨ xatsi xeikɨa kanihɨkɨtɨni kenemɨtixeiya. Nekaninewaɨriyani matsi Kɨritsitu nehexeiyatɨ nemayanikɨ,

hetsiena netiwiyatɨ yanepɨtixeiyariekakeyu xeikɨa. Nekɨmana heitserie nepɨkahexeiya, 'inɨari niukiyaritsie yanetikamietɨ heitserie nepɨkanepitɨa nekɨmana. Matsi heitserie kenemɨrexeiya, Kɨritsitu hetsie yuri nemɨti'eriekɨ pɨta heitserie nekanexeiyani, Kakaɨyari heitserie kemɨnetipitɨa yuri nemɨti'eriekɨ.

Mɨpaɨ xeikɨa nepɨtinewaɨriya, nemimaikakɨ Kɨritsitu, nehetsie nemimaikakɨ tɨrɨkariyaya kɨmana manukuketɨarie, ne hamatɨana temɨtaxewinikɨ kemɨtiukwinixɨ netimaitɨ, hepaɨna ne'anetɨ nemayanikɨ mɨkɨ ke'anetɨ matɨa 'umierieka.
Nekanaye'anikeyu xeikɨa nemanukuketɨarienikɨ mɨkite watsata.
Kemɨtiunanautsakai, he'iwake
'Akuxi mɨpaɨ nepɨka'ane, 'akuxi nepɨka'aye'awe. Kɨritsitu Ketsutsi pɨnetsi'u'axixɨ, neta nemi'axenikɨ tita mɨnetimini. 'Ayumieme nepɨnemexɨitɨa, yanemɨraye'anikɨ.
Ne'iwama, ne'aye'ame nepɨkane'erie 'akuxi. Peru tsikeretsɨ mɨpaɨ nekatiniyurieneni, nekanetɨmaiya netsutɨa mieme, nekaninetatuani matsi hikɨ nemi'axenikɨ neyeta mieme.
Yanetiunanautsatɨ nepɨnemexɨitɨa neme'iwakɨ, Kakaɨyari kemɨnetiuta'ini taheima miemekɨ nemɨ'ayumiemetɨnikɨ Kɨritsitu Ketsutsi hetsie netiwiyatɨ.
Ketapaɨmetɨ temɨtsetseɨye mɨpaɨ teketeku'eriwani. Xɨka yɨkɨ xeteku'eriwani, Kakaɨyari yakatinixehekɨatɨamɨkɨ.
Ketemɨte'aye'axɨawawe, mɨpaɨ yateketekahuni.
Ne'iwama, yaxeikɨa xekenene'ɨkeni ne kenemɨtiyuriene, tame 'inɨari tekanihɨkɨtɨni, mɨkɨ tahepaɨ memɨte'u'uwa, mɨkɨ xekeniwaxeiyani.
Yumɨiretɨ kememɨte'u'uwa, mekaneye'unieka Kɨritsitu kemɨtiumierie kuruxitsie. Wahepaɨtsita mɨixa netinixekuxaxatɨwakaitɨni, hikɨta yaxeikɨa nepaine ne'utatsuatɨ.
Mɨkɨ mekanika'unariekuni xeikɨa, yuhuka mekanayexeiyani yukakaɨyari hepaɨ. Witsime'aneneme mekaniyuxatani kepauka mɨpaɨ memɨyɨa ketemɨtetewiyatsitɨarie. Kwiepa timiemekɨ xeikɨa mekatena'eriwani.
Tame pɨta muyuawitsie tekanikiekataritɨni, 'ayumieme tekanikwewieka tatsiwikweitsitɨwame Ti'aitame Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu 'umamiekɨ.

Mɨkɨ yɨkɨ 'anekame tawaiyari kaneyeitɨamɨkɨ, hikɨ tixaɨtɨ tekatehɨkɨtɨtɨ 'ikɨ tawaiyaritsie tekaniu'uwani, peru 'ana yuwaiyari hepaɨ 'anekame kaneyeitɨamɨkɨ, witsi'anetɨ kemɨtiuyeika mɨkɨ, mɨpaɨ katiniyuriemɨkɨ yɨtɨrɨkariyakɨ, mɨpaɨ titɨrɨkaɨyetɨ kaniyɨweni naime yatikamieme mayeitɨanikɨ, mɨkɨ kemɨti'aita.
